bull_case: Rubrik is absorbing more than its current OCF into R&D and product investment while ARR and contribution margin rise. If SBC normalizes, the same reinvestment engine can convert into strong per-share cash compounding.
bear_case: Reported FCF masks heavy equity compensation. TTM SBC exceeds company-style FCF, and share count rose about 5% y/y. High reinvestment intensity does not yet prove high incremental ROIC for owners.
thesis: Reinvestment runway is long, but owner-level return quality is not yet proven. TTM R&D plus physical/software capex is roughly $492M versus about $337M OCF, an absorption ratio near 146%. ARR and margins are improving, yet SBC-adjusted owner FCF remains negative and dilution is material. The correct conclusion is high reinvestment intensity with uncertain incremental ROIC, not a mature compounding engine.

evidence.claim: TTM R&D is approximately $441.0M using FY2026 plus H1 FY2027 less H1 FY2026.
evidence.source: SEC FY2026 10-K, Q2 FY2027 10-Q and Q2 FY2026 10-Q

evidence.claim: TTM property/equipment capex plus capitalized internal-use software is about $50.8M; combined with R&D, internal reinvestment is about $491.8M.
evidence.source: SEC FY2026 and H1 FY2026/FY2027 cash-flow statements

evidence.claim: TTM OCF is about $337.1M, so (capex + capitalized software + R&D)/OCF is roughly 146%.
evidence.source: Arithmetic from frozen SEC financial inputs

evidence.claim: TTM company-style FCF is about $286.2M, but TTM SBC is about $341.8M, leaving an owner-FCF stress proxy near -$55.5M before any further dilution adjustment.
evidence.source: Arithmetic from frozen SEC financial inputs

evidence.claim: Subscription ARR grew 33% and contribution margin improved to 14.0% from 9.4%, indicating reinvestment is accompanied by operating progress rather than pure expense growth.

counterevidence: High reinvestment absorption can reflect inefficiency rather than attractive ROIC.
SBC-adjusted owner FCF is negative despite positive company-defined FCF.
Predibase and Agent Cloud returns are too early to measure.
unknowns: Incremental ARR contribution per dollar of R&D and S&M.
Normalized SBC after IPO-era equity awards.
Agent Cloud/Predibase return on invested capital.
falsifiers: Raise incremental_roic only when owner FCF/share turns positive while ARR stays above 20%.
Cut reinvestment_runway if ARR growth falls below 15% despite reinvestment above OCF.
Confirm dilution veto if >5% annual share growth persists for multiple years without per-share cash growth.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current dilution is material but only a limited post-IPO history is available; a long-duration pattern is not yet established. RF therefore penalizes FCF/share quality rather than confirming the veto.
Incremental ROIC is not reliably measurable yet, but ARR growth and contribution-margin improvement do not show a structural collapse. Uncertainty is scored at 50 rather than converted into a veto.

next_checks: Estimate incremental ARR contribution per R&D/S&M dollar.

subscores.rationale: ARR and contribution margins improve, but negative GAAP operating income and heavy SBC prevent reliable incremental ROIC measurement. The 50 uncertainty anchor is appropriate.

TTM internal reinvestment absorption is ~146%, above 60%, but the 90 row additionally requires incremental ROIC at least 2x cost of capital, which is not proven. The qualitative gate therefore caps this one row lower at 80.
Company-defined FCF is positive and rising, but TTM SBC exceeds that FCF and share count is rising. Owner FCF/share is still heavily distorted, matching the 50 anchor.

uncertainties.rationale: Intangible R&D investment and negative owner FCF make conventional ROIC unreliable.
High absorption is observable, but future return on that spending is uncertain.
SBC normalization and fully diluted share count are unresolved.
